headline: Institutional Investors and Foreign Funds Dump Heavily! Memory Stocks Hit by Sell-Off; "This One" Sees Nearly 100,000 Lots Sold Off and Becomes the Biggest Victim | Finance
summary: The KOSPI fell 7.57% on the 15th and at one point triggered the year's 10th circuit breaker. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix each fell nearly 10%, with Taiwan's memory sector also weak.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, and Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are leading memory chipmakers whose prices drive global DRAM and NAND cycles.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Market-wide sell-off of 7.57% in the benchmark index, triggering a circuit breaker.
